h1: Custom Set T Shirts for Teams & Events
metaTitle: Custom Set T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom set t shirts in bulk for your team or event. Fast turnaround & free setup at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Ordering custom set t shirts means every shirt in your order shares the same design, color, and style, creating a uniform look for your team, event, or company. Whether you need performance tees for a charity run or ring-spun cotton shirts for a company picnic, selecting a set ensures consistency across all sizes and quantities. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a professional finish that aligns with your brand.
heroAltText: Bulk custom set t shirts in assorted colors arranged in stacks, ready for screen printing or embroidery.
